title: Case 040: Cancelled order is packed but has not left the merchant warehouse

details.data: Entirely synthetic; English; fictional geography; all times UTC

context: The merchant has authorised cancellation while the packed item is still in its warehouse. Warehouse stop confirmation is required before calling dispatch cancelled.
initial_request: Please get the warehouse to stop DL-040 before the next outbound sweep. The cancellation is authorised, but the physical dispatch stop is not confirmed.
overview: The escalation snapshot comprises history events 001–002. Event 003 records the next agent action; the subsequent events provide the disclosed calibration follow-through. Facts learned later must not be used as if already known at escalation.

next_action.summary: Ask the warehouse to stop dispatch using the merchant's recorded cancellation authority.

outcome: The warehouse confirms the package was removed from outbound dispatch; refund processing remains separate.
boundaries: Dispatch stop is not a refund approval, payment or completed customer communication.

events.body: Cancellation CAN-040 is authorised for TG-040 at 08:45 UTC today. DL-040 is packed in outbound cage O7 and has no carrier handover scan. Refund processing is a separate task.
Please get the warehouse to stop DL-040 before the next outbound sweep. The cancellation is authorised, but the physical dispatch stop is not confirmed.
Apply CAN-040 to stop DL-040 in cage O7 now. Please confirm physical removal from outbound dispatch and the resulting shipment status.
At 09:45 UTC we removed DL-040 from outbound cage O7 into cancellation stock. Shipment status is dispatch stopped; no carrier handover occurred. Refund action is not performed by our team.
